messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look at the **federal public holidays** that create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falling on a Friday or a Monday) in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(Province‑specific holidays such as Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc., are listed where they apply.)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **April 7** | Friday | Good Friday | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (observed) | July 1 was Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **September 4** | Monday | Labour Day | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |

### Province‑specific long weekends (2023)

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long Weekend? |
|--------------------|---------|------|---------------|
| Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan | Family Day | February 20 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | Family Day | February 20 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| Nova Scotia | Family Day | February 20 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | June 24 (Thursday) | No (but many take June 23 off) |
| Ontario | Civic Holiday | August 7 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| British Columbia | Civic Holiday | August 7 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| Manitoba | Civic Holiday | August 7 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| Saskatchewan | Civic Holiday | August 7 (Monday) | Yes (Sat–Mon) |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | March 17 (Friday) | Yes (Fri–Sun) |
| Nunavut | National Indigenous Peoples’ Day | June 21 (Wednesday) | No (but many take June 20 off) |
| Yukon | National Indigenous Peoples’ Day | June 21 (Wednesday) | No (but many take June 20 off) |

> **Key points for your holiday‑planning app:**
> * The above federal holidays that fall on a Friday or a Monday automatically give users a 3‑day weekend without needing to request time off.
> * For holidays that fall on a Thursday or Tuesday (e.g., Remembrance Day on Wednesday, National Indigenous Peoples Day on Wednesday), users often take the adjacent weekday off to create a long weekend—this can be flagged as a “potential long weekend” in your app.
> * Some provinces observe holidays on different days (e.g., Family Day on the third Monday in February), so you may want to allow users to select their province/territory to see the exact dates.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown per province or if you need the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
